market.question: Will Crude Oil (CL) hit (HIGH) $120 by end of June?

assessment.reasoning: WTI ~$99 spot; CME settlement >= $120 requires +21% rise over ~2 months. The Feb 2026 spike high was ~$113-$117 intraday and likely lower on settlement basis. A persistent move to $120 settle implies significant escalation beyond what's currently priced.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Tail-risk geopolitical escalation (regional war, prolonged Hormuz closure).
